conventions.values: the other settings' values by key; a key that is absent is an absent field
conventions.field: what the setting declares: {required}; absent means required false
conventions.expect: {visible, required, enabled} the Framework decides and, unless server_only, the server decides too
conventions.expect_client: server_only cases: what sf-property-view 1.14.0 decides (it cannot read gt/gte/lt/lte, so the field is as declared)
conventions.expect_server: a rule the server refuses but whose evaluation differs between server and browser: the server's evaluation, for the record
conventions.expect_reject: the server refuses the rule before it is kept: part_unknown, node_invalid, field_invalid, operator_unknown, value_invalid, value_unexpected, too_deep
